name: Scribbr Citation Generator
description: Instantly get accurate citations for any webpage in APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard and any other style.
atGlance: Generate accurate citations for webpages directly from Chrome.
fullDescription: Scribbr Citation Generator is a Chrome extension for students, teachers, and researchers that creates reference list entries and in-text citations for online sources. It supports APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, and other styles, extracts key sentences with citations, and can generate page summaries for quick review.

coreFeatures.name: Multi-Style Citations
coreFeatures.description: Generates accurate citations for webpages in APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, and other styles.

coreFeatures.name: In-Page Research Workflow
coreFeatures.description: Creates reference list entries and in-text citations while browsing online sources.

coreFeatures.name: Key Sentence Extraction
coreFeatures.description: Extracts important sentences from a page with proper citation support.

coreFeatures.name: Page Summaries
coreFeatures.description: Generates concise summaries of webpages to speed up research review.

additionalFeatures.name: Chrome Web Store Installation
additionalFeatures.description: Installed directly from the Chrome Web Store as a browser extension.

additionalFeatures.name: Copy to Clipboard
additionalFeatures.description: Copies generated citations quickly into papers, notes, or documents.

additionalFeatures.name: No Ads
additionalFeatures.description: Designed as a free citation workflow without ads in the extension experience.
